awesomeListMeta.descriptionHTML: A curated list of awesome things related to FastAPI
awesomeListMeta.description: A curated list of awesome things related to FastAPI

nodes.itemHTML:
• Prisma Client Pythonstars110 - An auto-generated, fully type safe ORM powered by Pydantic and tailored specifically for your schema - supports SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, MariaDB and more.
    • FastAPI Example
• FastAPI Eventsstars23 - Asynchronous event dispatching/handling library for FastAPI and Starlette.
• FastAPI Cachestars279 - A tool to cache FastAPI response and function results, with support for Redis, Memcached, DynamoDB, and in-memory backends.
• ASGI Correlation IDstars33 - Request ID logging middleware.
• AuthXstars223 - Customizable Authentications and Oauth2 management for FastAPI.
• FastAPI Lazystars73 - Lazy package to start your project using FastAPI.
• Getting started with GraphQL in Python with FastAPI and Ariadne - Generate a FullStack playground using FastAPI, GraphQL and Ariadne.
• FastAPI Securitystars68 - Implements authentication and authorization as dependencies in FastAPI.

• FastAPI-CamelCase - CamelCase JSON support for FastAPI utilizing Pydantic.
    • CamelCase Models with FastAPI and Pydantic - Accompanying blog post from the author of the extension.
• Microsoft Azure App Service
• Strawberry GraphQLstars1.9k - Python GraphQL library based on dataclasses.
• FastAPI templatestars151 - Flexible, lightweight FastAPI project generator. It includes support for SQLAlchemy, multiple databases, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
• Bunnybookstars117 - A tiny social network built with FastAPI, React+RxJs, Neo4j, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
• FastAPI Azure Authstars118 - Azure AD authentication for your APIs with single and multi tenant support.
• FastAPI Usersstars1.5k - Account management, authentication, authorization.

• Tortoise ORM - An easy-to-use asyncio ORM (Object Relational Mapper) inspired by Django.
    • FastAPI Example - An example of the Tortoise-ORM FastAPI integration.
    • Tutorial: Setting up Tortoise ORM with FastAPI
    • Aerichstars438 - Tortoise ORM migrations tools.
• SQLModel - SQLModel (which is powered by Pydantic and SQLAlchemy) is a library for interacting with SQL databases from Python code, with Python objects.
• Beaniestars399 - Asynchronous Python ODM for MongoDB, based on Motor and Pydantic, which supports data and schema migrations out of the box.
• Universitiesstars48 - API service for obtaining information about +9600 universities worldwide.

• ormar - Ormar is an async ORM that uses Pydantic validation and can be used directly in FastAPI requests and responses so you are left with only one set of models to maintain. Alembic migrations included.
    • FastAPI Example - Using FastAPI with ormar.

• Building a Stock Screener with FastAPI - A you build a web-based stock screener with FastAPI, you'll be introduced to many of FastAPI's features, including Pydantic models, dependency injection, background tasks, and SQLAlchemy integration.
• ODMantic - AsyncIO MongoDB ODM integrated with Pydantic.
• FastAPI vs. Django vs. Flask - Which framework is best for Python in 2020? Which uses async/await the best? Which is the fastest?
• Introducing FARM Stack - FastAPI, React, and MongoDB - Getting started with a complete FastAPI web application stack.
• The Definitive Guide to Celery and FastAPI - Learn how to add Celery to a FastAPI application to provide asynchronous task processing.
• Build and Secure an API in Python with FastAPI - Secure and maintain an API based on FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.
• DogeAPIstars82 - API with high performance to create a simple blog and CRUD with OAuth2PasswordBearer.
• JeffQLstars20 - Simple authentication and login API using GraphQL and JWT.
• openapi-python-clientstars257 - Generate modern FastAPI Python clients (via FastAPI) from OpenAPI.
• FastAPIweestars13 - A simple way to create REST API based on PeeWeestars8.8k models.
• Async SQLAlchemy with FastAPI - Learn how to use SQLAlchemy asynchronously.
• Running FastAPI applications in production - Use Gunicorn with systemd for production deployments.
• Streaming video with FastAPI - Learn how to serve video streams.
• FastAPI Adminstars1k - Functional admin panel that provides a user interface for performing CRUD operations on your data.
• FastAPI Chameleonstars103 - Adds integration of the Chameleon template language to FastAPI.
• FastAPI Jinjastars45 - Adds integration of the Jinja template language to FastAPI.
• OpenTelemetry FastAPI Instrumentation - Library provides automatic and manual instrumentation of FastAPI web frameworks, instrumenting http requests served by applications utilizing the framework.
• OPAL (Open Policy Administration Layer)stars0 - Real-time authorization updates on top of Open-Policy; built with FastAPI, Typer, and FastAPI WebSocket pub/sub.
• FastAPI Code Generatorstars387 - Create a FastAPI app from an OpenAPI file, enabling schema-driven development.
• Modern APIs with FastAPI and Python - A course designed to get you creating new APIs running in the cloud with FastAPI quickly.
• Full Web Apps with FastAPI Course - You'll learn to build full web apps with FastAPI, equivalent to what you can do with Flask or Django.
• FastAPI Cloud Authstars160 - Simple integration between FastAPI and cloud authentication services (AWS Cognito, Auth0, Firebase Authentication).
• FastAPI Websocket Pub/Substars0 - The classic pub/sub pattern made easily accessible and scalable over the web and across your cloud in realtime.
• FastAPI Websocket RPCstars0 - RPC (bidirectional JSON RPC) over Websockets made easy, robust, and production ready.
• inboardstars79 - Docker images to power your FastAPI apps and help you ship faster.

• FastAPI Microservice Patterns - Blog post series with exemplary implementations of microservice patterns.
    • Local Development Environment - Skaffold, docker, kubectl and minikube in a nutshell.
    • Service discovery in Container Orchestration Platforms - Enabling FastAPI service communication in Kubernetes explained.
    • Asynchronous Communication - Enabling loosely coupled services with messaging.
    • Application Monitoring - Application metric monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.
    • Serverless Deployment - About the current status of the compatibility between FastAPI and Kubernetes-native FaaS platforms.

• Piccolostars625 - An async ORM and query builder, supporting Postgres and SQLite, with batteries (migrations, security, etc).
    • FastAPI Examplesstars8 - Using FastAPI with Piccolo.
    • Piccolo Adminstars95 - A powerful and modern admin GUI, using the Piccolo ORM.
• Deploy a Dockerized FastAPI App to Google Cloud Platform - A short guide to deploying a Dockerized Python app to Google Cloud Platform using Cloud Run and a SQL instance.
• FastAPI Profilerstars52 - A FastAPI Middleware of joerick/pyinstrument to check your service performance.
• FastAPI Paginationstars257 - Pagination for FastAPI.
• FastAPI Limiterstars90 - A request rate limiter for FastAPI.
• Coronavirus-tg-apistars10 - API for tracking the global coronavirus (COVID-19, SARS-CoV-2) outbreak.
• Implementing FastAPI Services – Abstraction and Separation of Concerns - FastAPI application and service structure for a more maintainable codebase.
• TestDriven.io FastAPI - Multiple FastAPI-specific articles that focus on developing and testing production-ready RESTful APIs, serving up machine learning models, and more.
• FastAPI MQTTstars90 - An extension for the MQTT protocol.
• Starlette Contextstars212 - Allows you to store and access the request data anywhere in your project, useful for logging.
• Starlette OpenTracingstars54 - Opentracing support for Starlette and FastAPI.
• Starlette Prometheusstars173 - Prometheus integration for FastAPI and Starlette.
• FastAPI CRUDRouterstars577 - A FastAPI router that automatically creates and documents CRUD routes for your models.
• Using Hypothesis and Schemathesis to Test FastAPI - Apply property-based testing to FastAPI.
• Prometheus FastAPI Instrumentatorstars178 - A configurable and modular Prometheus Instrumentator for your FastAPI application.
• Deploy Machine Learning Models with Keras, FastAPI, Redis and Docker
• Developing and Testing an Asynchronous API with FastAPI and Pytest - Develop and test an asynchronous API with FastAPI, Postgres, Pytest, and Docker using Test-Driven Development.
• FastAPI has Ruined Flask Forever for Me
• Demystifying Authentication with FastAPI and a Frontend - Add token-based authentication.
• FastAPI SocketIOstars115 - Easy integration for FastAPI and SocketIO.
• How to monitor your FastAPI service - Explains how to implement Application Performance Monitoring (APM) using OpenTelemetry and Datadog/Jaeger.
• Real-time data streaming using FastAPI and WebSockets - Learn how to stream data from FastAPI directly into a real-time chart.
• Mangum - Adapter for running ASGI applications with AWS Lambda and API Gateway.
• Deta (example)
• Manage FastAPIstars524 - CLI tool for generating and managing FastAPI projects.
• FastAPI JWT Authstars311 - JWT auth (based on Flask-JWT-Extendedstars1.3k).
• Awesome FastAPI Projectsstars399 - Organized list of projects that use FastAPI.
• FastAPI Mailstars258 - Lightweight mail system for sending emails and attachments (individual and bulk).
• FastAPI Simple Securitystars82 - Out-of-the-box API key security manageable through path operations.
• Heroku (Step-by-step tutorial, ML model on Heroku tutorial)
• Bitcartstars120 - Platform for merchants, users and developers which offers easy setup and use.
• FastAPI for Flask Users - Learn FastAPI with a side-by-side code comparison to Flask.
• FastAPI Cachestars165 - A simple lightweight cache system.
• MongoEngine - A Document-Object Mapper (think ORM, but for document databases) for working with MongoDB from Python.
• msgpack-asgistars87 - Automatic MessagePack content negotiation.
• Tutorial - Official tutorial showing you how to use FastAPI with most of its features, step by step.
• Gitter Chat - Chat with other FastAPI users.
• FastAPI on PythonBytes - Nice overview of the project.
• Why we switched from Flask to FastAPI for production machine learning - In-depth look at why you may want to move from Flask to FastAPI.
• Deploying Iris Classifications with FastAPI and Docker - Dockerizing a FastAPI application.
• How to deploy your ConvNet classifier with Keras and FastAPI - Deploy a machine learning model via a web-based API.
• Introduction to the FastAPI Python Framework - Quick intro to FastAPI.
• Porting Flask to FastAPI for ML Model Serving - Comparison of Flask vs FastAPI.
• Serving Machine Learning Models with FastAPI in Python - Use FastAPI to quickly and easily deploy and serve machine learning models in Python as a RESTful API.

• PyConBY 2020: Serve ML models easily with FastAPI - From the talk by Sebastian Ramirez you will learn how to easily build a production-ready web (JSON) API for your ML models with FastAPI, including best practices by default.
• PyCon UK 2019: FastAPI from the ground up - This talk shows how to build a simple REST API for a database from the ground up using FastAPI.
• Building Web APIs Using FastAPI - Use FastAPI to build a web application programming interface (RESTful API).
• FastAPI - A Web Framework for Python - See how to do numeric validations with FastAPI.
• Serving Machine Learning Models As API with FastAPI - Build a machine learning API with FastAPI.
• FastAPI and Tortoise ORMstars76 - Powerful but simple template for web APIs w/ FastAPI (as web framework) and Tortoise-ORM (for working via database without headache).
• cookiecutter-fastapistars142 - Cookiecutter template for FastAPI projects using: Machine Learning, Poetry, Azure Pipelines and pytest.
• FastAPI and React Templatestars954 - Full stack cookiecutter boilerplate using FastAPI, TypeScript, Docker, PostgreSQL, and React.
• FastAPI Websocket Broadcaststars85 - Websocket 'broadcast' demo.
• FastAPI with Celery, RabbitMQ, and Redisstars273 - Minimal example utilizing FastAPI and Celery with RabbitMQ for task queue, Redis for Celery backend, and Flower for monitoring the Celery tasks.
• JSON-RPC Serverstars141 - JSON-RPC server based on FastAPI.
• redis-streams-fastapi-chatstars81 - A simple Redis Streams backed chat app using Websockets, Asyncio and FastAPI/Starlette.
• TermPairstars1.3k - View and control terminals from your browser with end-to-end encryption.
• FastAPI Nanostars300 - Simple FastAPI template with factory pattern architecture.
• FastAPI Authstars69 - Pluggable auth that supports the OAuth2 Password Flow with JWT access and refresh tokens.
• FastAPI Loginstars270 - Account management and authentication (based on Flask-Loginstars3k).
• FastAPI Permissionsstars214 - Row-level permissions.
• FastAPI SQLAlchemystars381 - Simple integration between FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

• GINOstars2.3k - A lightweight asynchronous ORM built on top of SQLAlchemy core for Python asyncio.

• ORMstars1.5k - An async ORM.
• asyncpgsastars389 - A wrapper around asyncpgstars5.2k for use with SQLAlchemy Core.
• Databasesstars2.6k - Async SQL query builder that works on top of the SQLAlchemy Core expression language.
• Motor - Asynchronous Python driver for MongoDB.
• Pydantic-SQLAlchemystars691 - Convert SQLAlchemy models to Pydantic models.
• FastAPI Client Generatorstars219 - Generate a mypy- and IDE-friendly API client from an OpenAPI spec.
• FastAPI Versioningstars329 - API versioning.
• Jupyter Notebook REST APIstars37 - Run your Jupyter notebooks as RESTful API endpoints.
• FastAPI Contribstars437 - Opinionated set of utilities: pagination, auth middleware, permissions, custom exception handlers, MongoDB support, and Opentracing middleware.
• FastAPI Pluginsstars183 - Redis and Scheduler plugins.
• FastAPI ServiceUtilsstars30 - Generator for creating API services.
• FastAPI Utilitiesstars921 - Reusable utilities: class-based views, response inferring router, periodic tasks, timing middleware, SQLAlchemy session, OpenAPI spec simplification.
• Prerender Python Starlettestars14 - Starlette middleware for Prerender.
• SlowApistars364 - Rate limiter (based on Flask-Limiter).
• Starlette Exporterstars148 - One more prometheus integration for FastAPI and Starlette.
• Documentation - Comprehensive documentation.

• Build The Next Generation Of Python Web Applications With FastAPI - In this episode of Podcast Init, the create of FastAPI, Sebastián Ramirez, shares his motivations for building FastAPI and how it works under the hood.
• Test-Driven Development with FastAPI and Docker - Learn how to build, test, and deploy a text summarization microservice with Python, FastAPI, and Docker.
